contents.text: {"answer":"Recall 22V382000 is the most likely match because the owner reports a nonworking backup camera, and the recall describes a fault signal that may disable the reverse camera. It applies to certain Mustangs with 5.0L engines and manual transmissions; the records do not establish whether this vehicle has that engine and transmission. The decision remains that more information is needed to confirm the match.","scope":"answered","recheck":false,"citations":[{"kind":"complaint","id":"11591938","quote":"Backup camara is not working"},{"kind":"recall","id":"22V382000","quote":"The Powertrain Control Module (PCM) may broadcast an unintended faulted signal to the modules controlling the reverse camera, reverse light, and driver assist features, which may disable all of these functions."},{"kind":"recall","id":"22V382000","quote":"certain 2019-2020 Mustang vehicles equipped with 5.0L engines and manual transmissions"},{"kind":"complaint","id":"11591938","quote":"Recall 22V382000 may fit, but the complaint lacks the detail to confirm it."}]}
